home.conceptBody: While skin concerns may seem similar, the causes are all different. Sunshine Dermatology Clinic proposes the most suitable solutions by considering each patient's skin condition, lifestyle patterns, and desired future.
home.philosophyBody: We pursue necessary treatments over excessive ones, verified results over flashy advertisements, and healthy changes over temporary improvements. We aim to be your personal skin doctor who restores the natural health and beauty of your skin, giving you greater confidence in your daily life.

about.tourTitle: Take a Tour of Our Clinic

tour.title: A Calm Welcoming Space
tour.body: The first thing you encounter upon entering is the reception desk. The toned-down beige and warm indirect lighting gently ease your tension before treatment.

tour.title: Spacious Waiting Area
tour.body: With wide individual lounge seats, warm beverages, and ample natural light, we designed the waiting time to be comfortable.

tour.title: 1:1 Customized Treatment Room
tour.body: Treatments are conducted 1:1 in independent treatment rooms. We separate medical devices and hygiene pathways to ensure safety and privacy.

treatment.ctaBody: Our medical staff will analyze your condition and suggest the most suitable treatment.

lifting.label: Lifting
lifting.description: We diagnose the causes of sagging and wrinkles, combining equipment suitable for skin layers to design natural elasticity.

treatments.name: Ulthera Prime
treatments.summary: Precise stimulation of the deep dermis (SMAS) with ultrasound (HIFU) for fundamental lifting effects.

treatments.name: Thermage FLX
treatments.summary: Rearranging collagen with monopolar radiofrequency (RF) to enhance surface elasticity and skin texture.

treatments.name: InMode (Forma · Mini)
treatments.summary: Non-invasive care of facial contours and elasticity with monopolar/bipolar RF.

treatments.name: Shurink Universe · Olym
treatments.summary: Next-generation HIFU lifting tailored to depth with area-specific cartridges (1.5~9mm).

devices.name: Ulthera Prime
devices.desc: Next-generation ultrasound lifting device from Merz Aesthetics. Visualizes skin layers with ultrasound imaging and precisely targets the dermis and SMAS layers.

devices.name: Thermage FLX
devices.desc: 4th generation monopolar radiofrequency (RF) equipment. Shortens treatment time with an enlarged tip (4.0㎠) and automatically adjusts output with the AccuREP algorithm.

devices.name: Shurink Universe · Olym
devices.desc: Next-generation HIFU platform from Classys. Allows for depth-customized lifting with area-specific cartridges (1.5/3.0/4.5/6.0/9.0mm).

devices.name: InMode (Forma · Mini)
devices.desc: Monopolar/bipolar RF system from Israel's InMode. Non-invasively cares for facial contours and skin texture.

anti-aging.label: Anti-aging
anti-aging.description: Regenerative and volumizing boosters like Rejuran, Juvelook, Rituo and Exosome, together with Botox and filler, revive lost volume and elasticity from within.

whitening.label: WHITENING · REDNESS
whitening.description: We provide customized pigment treatments that analyze the depth and type of melasma and pigmentation precisely, reducing recurrence through laser combinations.

treatments.name: Melasma · Spots
treatments.summary: Customized toning that breaks down epidermal and dermal pigments step by step.

treatments.name: Freckles · Dark Spots · Liver Spots
treatments.summary: Neatly removing lesions with lasers tailored to the depth of the lesions.

treatments.name: Recalcitrant Pigmentation
treatments.summary: Stepwise treatment of tricky pigments like Ota and milk coffee spots.

treatments.name: Redness · Capillaries
treatments.summary: Calming redness and facial flushing with vascular lasers.

devices.name: Fotona StarWalker MAQX
devices.desc: Multi-wavelength hybrid laser from Fotona, combining Nd:YAG (1064㎚) + KTP (532㎚). Precisely breaks down pigments according to depth and type using Q-switched and Long-pulsed modes.

devices.name: Clarity II
devices.desc: Dual-wavelength laser with Nd:YAG + Alexandrite. Broadly cares for pigments and vascular lesions from the epidermis to deep dermis.

devices.name: VBeam (VBeam)
devices.desc: 595㎚ PDL vascular-specific laser from Candela. Selectively targets hemoglobin to calm redness and capillary expansion.

devices.name: Secret RF
devices.desc: Insulated microneedle + radiofrequency system. Assists in improving skin texture, regeneration after pigmentation, and fine scars.

acne.label: ACNE · SCAR · PORE
acne.description: From cause diagnosis to scar and pore reconstruction, we offer step-by-step programs tailored to the skin conditions of adolescents and adults.

treatments.name: Adolescent · Adult Acne
treatments.summary: A comprehensive program managing sebum, inflammation, and hormonal factors together.

treatments.name: Acne Pigmentation
treatments.summary: Stepwise improvement of remaining redness and brown pigmentation after inflammation.

treatments.name: Acne Scars
treatments.summary: Combination of laser and regenerative treatments to reconstruct depressed scars.

treatments.name: Pores
treatments.summary: Tightening enlarged pores for smooth skin texture.

devices.name: Capri (CO2)
devices.desc: Fractional CO2 laser. Reconstructs depressed acne scars and enlarged pores at a micro-column level.

devices.name: Mirajet Forte
devices.desc: Sprays high-pressure medical saline to non-invasively cleanse sebum and dead skin cells from pores.

devices.name: Secret RF
devices.desc: Insulated microneedle + radiofrequency. Reconstructs depressed scars and enlarged pores.

devices.name: InMode Morpheus
devices.desc: InMode Morpheus8 — microneedle + RF fractional resurfacing for acne scars, pores, and skin texture.

devices.name: VBeam (VBeam)
devices.desc: Selectively calms PIE (redness) pigmentation remaining after acne with a 595㎚ PDL laser.

skin-disease.label: SKIN DISEASE
skin-disease.description: Before cosmetic procedures, our medical staff diagnoses the causes of skin diseases and treats them based on evidence.

treatments.name: Athlete's Foot
treatments.summary: Accurately diagnosing fungal infections and providing treatment to reduce recurrence.

treatments.name: Psoriasis · Tinea Versicolor
treatments.summary: Long-term management plan for chronic inflammatory diseases.

treatments.name: Atopic Dermatitis
treatments.summary: Stepwise treatment and lifestyle management focused on restoring the skin barrier.

treatments.name: Burns
treatments.summary: Post-burn care aimed at minimizing scarring.

treatments.name: Hair Loss
treatments.summary: Diagnosis by cause and treatment to strengthen the scalp and hair.
